title: Erasure law for output fields
statement: For every bit string $x$, discarding the decoded optional output and retaining only the remaining suffix from the optional-output reader gives exactly the result of the two-bit skipper that accepts a pair $(a,b)$ precisely when $a=1$ or $b=0$.
replaced:
For every bit string $x$: discarding the parsed value from the optional-output
reader yields exactly the two-bit skipper whose validity predicate rejects only
the pair $01$.
